You can browse verified listings on [LabX Benchtop Centrifuges](https://www.labx.com/categories/centrifuge-benchtop) to find a wide selection of used and refurbished lab models.[[1]](https://www.labx.com/categories/centrifuge-benchtop)

Purchasing pre-owned equipment saves money while delivering reliable performance for medical, research, or industrial labs. Prices typically range from $25 for small mini-centrifuges to upwards of $15,000 for high-capacity refrigerated or industrial systems.[[1]](https://www.equipnet.com/category/centrifuges-43231/)[[2]](https://newlifescientific.com/collections/refrigerated-centrifuges)

### Where to Buy Used Centrifuges

- **Laboratory & Medical Marketplaces:** Check LabX Benchtop Centrifuges for a broad peer-to-peer and dealer inventory of standard lab models.[[1]](https://www.labx.com/categories/centrifuge-benchtop)
- **Industrial Equipment:** Visit [EquipNet Used Centrifuges](https://www.equipnet.com/category/centrifuges-43231/) if you need large-scale processing, decanter, or basket centrifuges for manufacturing or chemical processing.[[1]](https://ssllc.com/catalog/lab-equipment/centrifuges?hierarchicalMenu%5Bcategories.lvl0%5D=Facilities%20%26%20Office%20Equipment%20%3E%20Computer%20and%20IT%20%3E%20Computer%20Monitors&page=1&configure%5Bpage%5D=1&configure%5BhitsPerPage%5D=10)[[2]](https://www.equipnet.com/category/centrifuges-43231/)
- **Specialty Dealers:** Browse [Dr's Toy Store](https://www.drstoystore.com/medical-equipment/centrifuges/) for medical-grade and clinical centrifuges with pricing and availability details.[[1]](https://www.drstoystore.com/medical-equipment/centrifuges/)
- **Refurbished Specialists:** Companies like New Life Scientific test motors and refrigeration units before resale.[[1]](https://newlifescientific.com/collections/refrigerated-centrifuges)

### Key Factors When Buying Used

- **Speed and Capacity:** Match the maximum RPM and RCF (relative centrifugal force) to your specific testing protocols.[[1]](https://newlifescientific.com/collections/centrifuges)
- **Rotor Type:** Confirm whether the unit includes fixed-angle or swing-out rotors, and check compatibility with your tube sizes.[[1]](https://newlifescientific.com/collections/centrifuges)
- **Condition and Testing:** Look for sellers who verify that the motor, digital controls, and refrigeration systems (if applicable) function properly under a test spin.[[1]](https://newlifescientific.com/collections/refrigerated-centrifuges)

To help narrow down the right used centrifuge, please tell me:

- What is your **intended application** (e.g., clinical blood separation, cell biology, or industrial processing)?
- What **tube sizes or sample volumes** do you plan to run?
- Do you require **refrigeration** , and what is your target **budget**?
